Solution B is correct. Expanding $(x+1.3)^2 + c$ gives $x^2 + 2.6x + 1.69 + c$. Matching the constant term requires $1.69 + c = 3.6$, so $c = 1.91$. Then $b + c = 1.3 + 1.91 = 3.21$.

Solution A has the right $b = 1.3$, but it computes $c$ incorrectly. It writes $3.6 - 1.3^2 = 0.31$, when $3.6 - 1.69 = 1.91$. That arithmetic error gives the wrong final answer of 1.61.

WINNER: B
